implementation_timing.reason: Exact control and candidate routed reports.

long_stability.reason: Three short matched pairs, no long-run claim.

memory.reason: Original model/cache arithmetic is fixed. Both images use the same model, cache layout and input/output buffer capacity. Host peak memory is unmeasured.

memory_bandwidth.reason: Unchanged memory footprint and operands. Physical interface bandwidth was outside this comparison.

model_quality.reason: The frozen model and retained calculations are unchanged.

operating_conditions.reason: Reported clock verified at gates. Continuous clock/thermal traces unavailable.

sources: All six arm block.json files and candidate cap/compact receipts

power_validation.reason: Scoped VCC_SOM observer used. Independent absolute calibration is outside scope.

prefill.reason: Physical end-to-end first byte is measured. Only the separate matched RTL replay splits the pre-projection prefix from final scoring.

recovery.reason: Exact original research circuit and all 320 pinned BOS scores restored.

sources: Per-case raw timestamps and three paired summaries

resources.reason: Static reports for the exact routed circuits.

serving_load.reason: Only the bounded fixed isolated circuit comparison was run.

stage_cycles.reason: Exact first, last and terminal board counts against both RTL arms. Phase attribution is from simulation.

sources.role: Board cycle counters versus both full RTL arms

startup.reason: Setup retained separately, no cold-start comparison.

sources: CPU-observed output_ns arrays in each block.json

workload_coverage.reason: Historical fixed three-prompt workload, exact common reference pins.

serial_link_qualification.energy_scope: Both USB companion hubs absent on both arms. Compare within this boot.
serial_link_qualification.physical_preflight: Pass after exact whole-archive UART transfer

correctness.evidence: Exact full-score diagnostics, compact and capped checks, all 36 timed and 18 warm-up requests, and first/last/terminal cycle counters passed. Restored original firmware and weights matched all 320 BOS scores.

configuration.final_state: Original firmware and original weights restored, 320 original BOS scores verified
configuration.firmware_identity_scope: Initial and restored stock firmware. Timed images are listed in comparison_firmware.

limitations: Single physical KV260 and one board boot with three fixed requests and matched repeats.
Power covers VCC_SOM module rail only. Active blocks include the same verification and request gaps; whole-board input energy was not measured.
The original firmware and weights passed functional BOS checking. Full configuration or weight-memory readback was outside scope.
Two supplemental post-restore snapshots show six changed SPI1 clock enable/count rows. All clock rates, original 50 MHz inference and final UART checks agree.
The third candidate block ended with SPI1 enabled. Other captured arm boundaries show it disabled. Its timing within sampled windows is unknown.

protocol.measurement_boundary: Board CPU request admission before encoding/clear through first/last useful byte and stop/drain. Six-request gross VCC_SOM block energy ends after verification. Load, switching, full-score diagnostics and UART export excluded.
protocol.quality_gate: Exact full-score diagnostics and same exact capped and uncapped completions and stops.
protocol.tokenizer: BOS plus two hex digit IDs per input UTF-8 byte. Useful outputs are byte IDs and exclude EOS.
protocol.warmup: Three exact requests per arm with loaded weights.

quality.evidence: Frozen model weights, numerical rules and decoding unchanged. Scope limited to the fixed cases.
